text: I’ve learned to get nervous when somebody "knows" too much about me/us too soon. You know how it goes: “We’re twin flames!” or “I’m Lord Krishna and she’s Radha!” Okay, maybe I really am way better than the other guys she’s found. But if she hasn’t found anything about me that bothers her yet, she hasn’t found all of me.
